scripts.dev:fullstack: concurrently -n "REACT,LARAVEL,PYTHON" -c "blue,yellow,green" "npm run dev:react" "npm run dev:laravel" "npm run dev:python"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "REACT,LARAVEL,PYTHON,ELECTRON" -c "blue,yellow,green,magenta" "npm run dev:react" "npm run dev:laravel" "npm run dev:python" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:all:no-python: concurrently -n "REACT,LARAVEL,ELECTRON" -c "blue,yellow,magenta" "npm run dev:react" "npm run dev:laravel" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run dev:electron"
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -n "REACT,LARAVEL,PYTHON" -c "blue,yellow,green" "npm run dev:react" "npm run dev:laravel" "npm run dev:python" && wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron electron/main.cjs
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run rebuild:serialport && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run rebuild:serialport && electron-builder --win
